name: Release
description: Controlled CAPITAL-AI release lifecycle, single platform-version authority and fail-closed read-only projection services. package.json#version is authoritative; final Git tags are prohibited until production acceptance.

events.note: The version gate does not emit synthetic release events. EventMesh publication may be added only when a real accepted release state transition is persisted.

note: scripts/automation/releaseVersion.ts is dry-run by default and requires explicit --apply. It changes package.json/lock/direct technical mirrors, regenerates README deterministically, executes hygiene/governance/build/predeploy gates, restores the complete rollback set on failure, writes release-candidate evidence only after gates pass and never creates a final Git tag. Legacy VersionManager mutation/state/document-generation semantics are suspended under ADR-0096.
